'''Norowhin''' is a member of the [[Children of the Light]]. 

==Appearance==
He is hard-eyed with a thrusting nose. He is not handsome. He is about the same height as [[Martyn Tallanvor]].

==History==
He is a young member of the Children, the same age as Tallanvor.

He talks very little.

==Activities==
He is placed in charge of the group of soldiers who guard [[Morgase Trakand]] when she leaves the confines of the [[Fortress of the Light]]. 

He is disgusted by the [[Dragonsworn]].

He refuses to be drawn into any type of conversation with Morgase, despite her repeated attempts to get information out of him.
